description: Hydrogen spectral lines for a series (nLow=1 Lyman, 2 Balmer, 3 Paschen...). Gives the wavelength IN VACUUM and IN AIR, which are different numbers: H-alpha is 656.47 nm in vacuum and 656.28 in air, and confusing them is common. Uses the reduced-mass Rydberg constant (R_H), not R-infinity.
name: hydrogen_spectrum
